native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.01 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S28,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
